---- MODULE ivy_examples_tlb ----
EXTENDS ivy_examples_tlbDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS

LOCAL TlbFS == INSTANCE FiniteSetTheorems

\* Control-state classes for map-lock ownership, action-lock ownership,
\* and the intervals in which a processor may have a stale TLB.
TlbSendPC == {InitiatorForSend, InitiatorCheckCpuPmap,
  InitiatorLockAction, InitiatorSetActionNeeded, InitiatorUnlockAction,
  InitiatorInterrupt}
TlbAfterSendPC == {InitiatorWaitForQuiescence, InitiatorUpdateEntry,
  InitiatorMaybeRefreshOwnTlb, InitiatorUnlockPmap}
TlbPmapPC == TlbSendPC \cup TlbAfterSendPC
TlbCurrentPC == TlbSendPC \ {InitiatorForSend}
TlbMatchedPC == TlbCurrentPC \ {InitiatorCheckCpuPmap}
TlbAHoldPC == {InitiatorSetActionNeeded, InitiatorUnlockAction}
TlbRHoldPC == {ResponderRefreshTlb, ResponderClearActionNeeded,
  ResponderUnlockAction}
TlbNotifiedPC == {ResponderCheck, ResponderDeactivate, ResponderLockAction}
TlbCriticalPC == {MainCheck, MainChoose, InitiatorDeactivate}
TlbNormalPC == TlbPmapPC \cup {InitiatorLockPmap, InitiatorReactivate,
  MainHandleInterrupt}
TlbActivePC == TlbCriticalPC \cup {Boot, MainHandleInterrupt,
  ResponderCheck, ResponderDeactivate}
TlbPC == TlbActivePC \cup TlbNormalPC \cup TlbRHoldPC \cup
  {ResponderLockAction, ResponderReactivate}

TlbType ==
  /\ pc \in [Processor -> TlbPC]
  /\ userpmap \in [Processor -> PMap]
  /\ writepmap \in [Processor -> PMap]
  /\ actionlock \in [Processor -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ actionneeded \in [Processor -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ active \in [Processor -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ interrupt \in [Processor -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ currentcpu \in [Processor -> Processor]
  /\ plock \in [PMap -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ tlb \in [Processor -> PageEntry]
  /\ pentry \in [PMap -> PageEntry]
  /\ todo \in [Processor -> [Processor -> BOOLEAN]]
  /\ error \in BOOLEAN

TlbActivity == \A p \in Processor : active[p] <=> pc[p] \in TlbActivePC
TlbMapLocks ==
  /\ \A m \in PMap : plock[m] <=>
       \E p \in Processor : pc[p] \in TlbPmapPC /\ writepmap[p] = m
  /\ \A p,q \in Processor :
       (pc[p] \in TlbPmapPC /\ pc[q] \in TlbPmapPC /\
        writepmap[p] = writepmap[q]) => p = q
TlbActionLocks ==
  /\ \A q \in Processor : actionlock[q] <=>
       (pc[q] \in TlbRHoldPC \/
        \E p \in Processor : pc[p] \in TlbAHoldPC /\ currentcpu[p] = q)
  /\ \A p \in Processor : pc[p] \in TlbAHoldPC =>
       pc[currentcpu[p]] \notin TlbRHoldPC
TlbCurrent ==
  /\ \A p \in Processor : pc[p] \in TlbCurrentPC =>
       /\ currentcpu[p] # p
       /\ pc[currentcpu[p]] # Boot
       /\ ~todo[p][currentcpu[p]]
  /\ \A p \in Processor : pc[p] \in TlbMatchedPC =>
       userpmap[currentcpu[p]] = writepmap[p]
TlbTodo == \A p,q \in Processor :
  todo[p][q] => (q # p /\ pc[q] # Boot)

\* A completed notification cannot be cleared while the sending
\* initiator still owns the corresponding map lock.
TlbMarked(q) == actionneeded[q] /\ pc[q] \notin TlbRHoldPC
TlbNotified(q) == TlbMarked(q) /\
  (interrupt[q] \/ pc[q] \in TlbNotifiedPC)
TlbSent(p,q) ==
  \/ pc[p] \in TlbAfterSendPC
  \/ /\ pc[p] \in TlbSendPC
     /\ ~todo[p][q]
     /\ pc[p] = InitiatorForSend \/ currentcpu[p] # q
TlbNotices == \A p,q \in Processor :
  (pc[p] \in TlbPmapPC /\ q # p /\ pc[q] # Boot /\
   userpmap[q] = writepmap[p]) =>
    /\ TlbSent(p,q) => TlbNotified(q)
    /\ (pc[p] \in {InitiatorUnlockAction, InitiatorInterrupt} /\
        currentcpu[p] = q) => TlbMarked(q)
TlbQuiescent == \A p,q \in Processor :
  (q # p /\ pc[q] # Boot /\ userpmap[q] = writepmap[p] /\
   (pc[p] \in TlbAfterSendPC \ {InitiatorWaitForQuiescence} \/
    (pc[p] = InitiatorWaitForQuiescence /\ ~todo[p][q]))) =>
    pc[q] \notin TlbCriticalPC
TlbOwnDirty(q) == pc[q] = InitiatorMaybeRefreshOwnTlb /\
  userpmap[q] = writepmap[q]
TlbCoherent == \A q \in Processor :
  (pc[q] \in TlbCriticalPC \/
   (pc[q] # Boot /\ ~actionneeded[q] /\ ~TlbOwnDirty(q)) \/
   (pc[q] \in TlbNormalPC /\ ~interrupt[q] /\ ~TlbOwnDirty(q)) \/
   pc[q] \in {ResponderClearActionNeeded, ResponderUnlockAction}) =>
    tlb[q] = pentry[userpmap[q]]

TlbInv == TlbType /\ TlbActivity /\ TlbMapLocks /\ TlbActionLocks /\
  TlbCurrent /\ TlbTodo /\ TlbNotices /\ TlbQuiescent /\ TlbCoherent /\ ~error

LEMMA TlbValues == {Boot, MainCheck, MainChoose, MainHandleInterrupt, InitiatorDeactivate, InitiatorLockPmap, InitiatorForSend, InitiatorCheckCpuPmap, InitiatorLockAction, InitiatorSetActionNeeded, InitiatorUnlockAction, InitiatorInterrupt, InitiatorWaitForQuiescence, InitiatorUpdateEntry, InitiatorMaybeRefreshOwnTlb, InitiatorUnlockPmap, InitiatorReactivate, ResponderCheck, ResponderDeactivate, ResponderLockAction, ResponderRefreshTlb, ResponderClearActionNeeded, ResponderUnlockAction, ResponderReactivate} \subseteq TlbPC

LEMMA TlbActionUnique == TlbInv =>
  \A p,q \in Processor :
    (pc[p] \in TlbAHoldPC /\ pc[q] \in TlbAHoldPC /\
     currentcpu[p] = currentcpu[q]) => p = q
